commentary.text: 90+8' Francisco Maeso is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

90+6' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Karl Hein sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
90+4' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+4' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
90+3' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Karl Hein comes off the line to clear the ball away.
90+1' 3 - 1 Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' Raul Moro (Valladolid) works the corner short.
89' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is substituted due to injury. Claudio Giraldez gives a chance to Joseph Aidoo.

87' Raul Moro (Valladolid) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Selim Amallah trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kenedy (Valladolid).
85' The goal by Celta Vigo is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
85' Wait! Referee Francisco Maeso has indicated he is going to review the Celta Vigo goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
85' Goal! The rebound fell to Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) and he fired home from close range. The score is 3:1.
84' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
81' Mario Martin (Valladolid) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Francisco Maeso sends him off the pitch.
81' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) inside the box.
80' A pass by Raul Moro (Valladolid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
78' Celta Vigo take a short corner kick.

78' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the roof of the net. Karl Hein is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Celta Vigo have a corner.
76' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
76' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Pablo Duran is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) for Jailson.
73' A cooling break is underway.
73' Good chance! Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
71' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
70' Mario Martin (Valladolid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francisco Maeso no option but to blow his whistle.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Mingueza leaves the pitch and Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) comes on.
69' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) replaces Borja Iglesias.
68' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is given a yellow card.
65' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) commits a foul and Francisco Maeso immediately signals a free kick.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Stanko Juric (Valladolid) will replace Eray Comert.
63' Eray Comert (Valladolid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
61' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
61' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
59' Rough tackle by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for an infringement.
55' Caution goes to Selim Amallah (Valladolid).
55' Valladolid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

54' A lofted cross from Luis Perez (Valladolid) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag and Valladolid will take a corner.
54' The corner is swung in but Valladolid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

53' Luis Perez (Valladolid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Valladolid can continue in their attacking effort.
52' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) was too forceful with his tackle and Francisco Maeso interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
50' 2 - 1 Raul Moro (Valladolid) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Vicente Guaita with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.
50' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
48' Luis Perez (Valladolid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' Half-time substitution. Chuki is replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
46' Paulo Pezzolano makes a switch. Victor Andres Meseguer Cavas is coming on in place of Kike Perez (Valladolid) at the start of the second period.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paulo Pezzolano gives a chance to Raul Moro and Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' The ball is cleared after Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45+4' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
45+4' Referee Francisco Maeso makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
45+4' One of the Valladolid players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
45+2' Chuki (Valladolid) picks up a yellow card.
45+1' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' The linesman raises his flag. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is adjudged offside.
44' Karl Hein is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo). Easy save!
43' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is caught offside!
42' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vicente Guaita intercepts the ball.
41' The foul by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Francisco Maeso.
40' Francisco Maeso shows the yellow card to Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) for a heavy challenge.
38' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
38' Dangerous play by Mario Martin (Valladolid). Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
35' 2 - 0 Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
35' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
34' Chuki (Valladolid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
31' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
31' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
30' A loose ball is pounced on by Jailson (Celta Vigo) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the top of the net, but Karl Hein is alert and makes a comfortable save.
29' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but it's cleared.
29' Valladolid players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
26' Pablo Duran received a clever long ball from Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
25' The foul by Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) was seen by Francisco Maeso who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
22' 1 - 0 Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Karl Hein with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 1:0.
21' Luis Perez (Valladolid) swings it in and Juanmi Latasa gets on the end of it, but Vicente Guaita shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
19' Great teamplay by Valladolid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
17' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
15' Amath Ndiaye (Valladolid) makes a strong challenge and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul.
14' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Celta Vigo.
12' Eray Comert (Valladolid) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
11' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Karl Hein comes off the line to clear the ball away.
9' Pablo Duran almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Celta Vigo.
7' Celta Vigo force their opponents to concede a corner.
6' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety. It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.
6' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
5' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
2' Chuki (Valladolid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
1' Selim Amallah (Valladolid) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Valladolid will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Francisco Maeso.
